ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the legend on the right side of the figure shows that the dashed line represents the highway line, and the solid lines represent contour lines. In the steep-slope section where the contour lines are relatively dense in the figure, the dashed highway does not go straight up and down the slope, but turns back left and right many times, with a form similar to the Chinese character "zhi". Then reason: dense contour lines indicate a relatively steep slope; on steep-slope sections, mountainous highways increase this kind of back-and-forth bend to lengthen the route and reduce the gradient, so "zhi"-shaped bends should be increased.

method.method_draft: 读取题干要求回答“在陡坡路段修建公路时应增加什么样的弯曲”。先根据图例把虚线识别为公路规划线；再在图中等高线较密集处观察公路不是直线上下坡，而是多次左右折返，形态类似“之”字。结合山区公路设计常识，将这种弯曲命名为“之”字形弯曲。
